races.name: Pertemps Network Long Distance Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Harbour Lake
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who won this race last year and typically delivers his best when others have set it up
runners_data.comment: Won by a neck in this race last year off 1lb lower; has to be considered seriously
runners_data.spotlight: Won by a neck in this race (good) last year off 1lb lower, having been third in it the year before; 33-1 sixth at Aintree last month suggested he's working his way back to that level, so has to be considered seriously.

runners_data.name: Deep Cave
runners_data.note: Strong traveller from the back who has won his last three starts and benefits from patient tactics
runners_data.comment: Backward steps on last three starts over fences; well handicapped on best chase efforts
runners_data.spotlight: 3m hat-trick in 2025 started with a success over hurdles at Aintree (good) in April before two chase wins late in the year; three marked backward steps over fences since but he's well handicapped on best chase efforts.

runners_data.name: Lord Snootie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with inconsistent form but placed twice at this course and distance previously
runners_data.comment: Placed twice from four starts over C&D but inconsistent and rules strike-rate is only 1-18
runners_data.spotlight: Inconsistent and only 1-18 under rules; placed twice from four starts over C&D, including when third to Serious Chat on latest start, but there appear to be more potent options among his rivals.

runners_data.name: Matty's Getaway
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making hurdles debut after wind surgery, adding headgear for first time
runners_data.comment: Second run after wind op; new trip makes appeal for this unexposed handicap debutant
runners_data.spotlight: Irish point winner who comfortably accounted for a subsequent Grade 2 novice winner in maiden at Doncaster (2m5f, good to soft) in November; had wind surgery soon afterwards and came a satisfactory second of four in novice here (2m5f, good) on last month's return; the longer trip is an appealing option for this unexposed handicap debutant.

runners_data.name: La Pinsonniere
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer but has only won once from 13 starts despite regular placing
runners_data.comment: Rallied into remote second here last time; perhaps first attempt beyond 2m5f will help
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent sort but she's won just once (a maiden last January) from 13 starts; rallied into a remote second here (good) last time, so perhaps a first attempt beyond that 2m5f will help the cause.

runners_data.name: Serious Chat
runners_data.note: Forward-going regular winner who showed battling qualities when winning here last month off 7lb lower mark
runners_data.comment: Regular winner and raised 5lb after C&D win last month; highly respected
runners_data.spotlight: Regular winner, including of ten-runner C&D race (good) last month when he travelled up smoothly to lead two out before answering some serious questions; raised another 5lb but highly respected after that career best.

runners_data.name: Eagle Fang
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning to hurdles in first-time visor, excellent second at Aintree last time suggests he's in form
runners_data.comment: Excellent second at Aintree four weeks ago; back up 2lb but a serious each-way player
runners_data.spotlight: Back hurdling (from chasing) in a first-time visor when an excellent second of 22 at Aintree (3m, good to soft) four weeks ago, always prominent; back up 2lb but a serious each-way player.

runners_data.name: Flying Fortune
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from long break, best effort this year was latest when fourth at similar level
runners_data.comment: Bit of a revival last time gave encouragement for longer trip; cheekpieces go on
runners_data.spotlight: Won four on the trot in July-October 2024 at about 2m4f, culminating in a Grade 2 novice event; long absence before three runs this year, easily best of those last time and that display gave some encouragement for this longer trip, but jumping was sketchy and cheekpieces are now applied.

runners_data.name: Gold For Alec
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse ridden by 3lb claimer, last won over this course and distance in good conditions

runners_data.name: Bold Endeavour
runners_data.note: Prominent 10-year-old who showed retained ability early last season but has been disappointing since
runners_data.comment: Pulled up at Aintree last time; well handicapped on old form but no win since Jan 2023
runners_data.spotlight: Back with Nicky Henderson last season and showed he retained a chunk of ability on first two starts, latterly when seventh of 24 in the Pertemps Final at Cheltenham (3m, good); made the running at Aintree (22-1) four weeks ago but ended pulled up; remains well handicapped on old form but there's been no win since January 2023.

runners_data.name: Al Sayah
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner whose recent wins have all come in May, now 5lb higher after easy Taunton success
runners_data.comment: Won at Taunton (3m; 4 ran) latest; might have more to offer as a stayer with new headgear
runners_data.spotlight: First four hurdle wins came in the month of May, before he took a four-runner race at Taunton (3m, good) last month; 5lb higher in today's much more competitive affair but that was his first attempt over this far and he might have more to offer as a stayer; first visor replaces cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Tranquil Sea
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with two wind operations who bounced back to form with convincing Plumpton win last time
runners_data.comment: Surged back from lean spell with 5l win at Plumpton three weeks ago; career best needed
runners_data.spotlight: Had one wind operation last November and another this March; surged back from a lean spell with 5l win at Plumpton (3m1f, good) three weeks ago on a rare run in cheekpieces, which are retained, but today's 7lb higher mark in a warm race demands a career best.

runners_data.name: Moon d'Orange
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who saves best for big occasions, inconsistent chaser making hurdles return in visor
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent chaser; has shown form only once from seven attempts under rules over 3m+
runners_data.spotlight: Inconsistent chaser who's saved his best for Cheltenham in 2025 and 2026, including a win (his only handicap success) in January 2025 and third at the Festival this March; both were over an extended 2m4f and he's shown his form only once from seven attempts under rules over 3m+; not the percentage call.

runners_data.name: Sea The Clouds
runners_data.note: Prominent runner having first start for 166 days with 10lb claiming jockey taking over
runners_data.comment: Hurdles form does not look quite good enough in this higher grade; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles form (handicap winner over 2m4f-3m1f) does not look quite good enough in this higher grade and the form of his winning chase debut at Cartmel last July has been followed by heavy defeats in both starts since (ridden by this 10lb claimer on latest); others preferred.

runners_data.name: Walking On Air
runners_data.note: Prominent performer who sparked into form at Doncaster last time, often tongue-tied and tries different headgear
runners_data.comment: Last hurdle race was February 2024; sparked rarely of late; others look a lot more solid
runners_data.spotlight: Sparked just once in each of the last two seasons, at Doncaster; visored on latest start, after three runs in cheekpieces; often tongue tied as well but goes without any equipment today; his last hurdle race was in February 2024 and other options look a lot more solid.

races.paceDynamic: Al Sayah is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, but six horses (Matty's Getaway, La Pinsonniere, Serious Chat, Eagle Fang, Bold Endeavour, Sea The Clouds, Walking On Air) want prominent positions creating a traffic jam. This congestion will intensify approaching the business end with horses struggling for room 2-3 out. The sustainable early gallop set by uncontested Al Sayah, combined with the prominent logjam, strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the squeeze and deliver their challenge from cleaner water.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Deliver
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets tangled up from 3 out as predicted
scenarios.body: The pace setters create perfect conditions for patient riders to weave through and strike late. Harbour Lake, Deep Cave and Flying Fortune benefit from clean runs while the early leaders tire from battling each other.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Survives Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners finds enough room to kick clear 2 out
scenarios.body: The early pace proves sustainable enough for a forward-going horse to tough it out despite the crowding. Eagle Fang or Serious Chat use their class to emerge from the scrum.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Al Sayah Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner's sustainable gallop proves too tactical for closers
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader gets such an easy time in front that he has enough left to repel late challenges. Al Sayah's 5lb rise proves insufficient to stop his winning run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Al Sayah goes too slowly and no prominent runner commits early enough
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with the entire field still in contention at the last. This chaotic finale suits horses with turn of foot regardless of early position.

watchPoints.text: Al Sayah must go a sensible gallop early or he'll have no answer to closers in the straight
The prominent bunch of Eagle Fang, Serious Chat, Matty's Getaway and La Pinsonniere getting bunched up from 3 out where the track narrows
Harbour Lake's jumping which can be sketchy when he's not fully tuned up, crucial for his chances of repeating last year's win
Flying Fortune needs to settle better than in his three runs this year to be effective from off the pace
Deep Cave's ability to handle the step back to hurdles after his recent chase wins over fences

races.name: Pertemps Network Swinton Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Alnilam
runners_data.note: Non-runner, prominent racer who would have benefited from the expected strong pace
runners_data.comment: Failed to progress over fences and now has something to prove back over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Made a promising start to his chasing career last autumn, winning twice at around 2m, but he failed to go on and was pulled up at Aintree in April; now has something to prove back over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Helnwein
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with course form, 11-race losing streak is a concern but Bellamy knows the horse well
runners_data.comment: Held when falling in the Plumpton race won by Indemnity; opposable off an unchanged mark
runners_data.spotlight: Often gives his running in strong handicaps (second in this event 12 months ago) but losing sequence is up to 11 and he looked held when falling two out in the Plumpton race won by Indemnity last time; cheekpieces left off today; opposable off unchanged mark.

runners_data.name: Dance And Glance
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent C&D form, won here last time with three of today's rivals behind
runners_data.comment: Progressive; had two of these behind when winning over C&D last month; solid claims
runners_data.spotlight: 5-14 strike-rate and steadily progressive form, gaining his latest success over this C&D (good ground; three of today's rivals behind) in convincing fashion; a 6lb rise does not look harsh, and with further improvement on the cards he has solid claims.

runners_data.name: Tellherthename
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 57-day break, caught the eye at Cheltenham on stable debut for Skelton
runners_data.comment: Caught eye in County at Cheltenham on first start for current yard; unexposed; big chance
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced for his age; caught the eye in no uncertain terms when twelfth of 23 in the County at Cheltenham on first start for current yard, travelling smoothly but short of room in straight and finishing full of running; very best efforts for previous stables came on good ground and he missed the Scottish Champion when the rain came; still unexposed and a fascinating contender in a first-time hood.

runners_data.name: Frontier Prince
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was fourth to Dance And Glance here last time, consistency his main weapon
runners_data.comment: Another creditable run when fourth over C&D last time but the handicapper seems in charge
runners_data.spotlight: Has proved a model of consistency in the last 12 months and he rallied for fourth behind Dance And Glance over C&D last time; however, that run underlined that the handicapper appears to have his measure for now; needs to be boosted by the fitting of cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Bubble Dubi
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 63-day break, limited recent form but has class on his day
runners_data.comment: Returned from long break to win at Aintree but has failed to repeat the form; bit to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Has run just four times since 2023; returned from long absence to win at Aintree (2m1f, good to soft) last November but failed to repeat the form in prestigious handicaps at Newbury and Sandown; something to prove.

runners_data.name: Mr McLoughlan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse and free-goer, needs to settle better than usual to be effective late
runners_data.comment: Again too free here last time; should get cover in a big field and could outrun his odds
runners_data.spotlight: Free-goer who was on a roll last autumn, winning three times; well held behind Star Of Guiting at Musselburgh on New Year's Day and couldn't land a blow behind Dance And Glance over C&D last month, but he should get plenty of cover in this big field and could outrun his likely odds.

runners_data.name: Magna Victor
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has been campaigned mainly in Scotland, recent form shows improvement
runners_data.comment: Creditable third at Ayr three weeks ago but needs a personal best off an unchanged mark
runners_data.spotlight: Trained in Shropshire but has raced mainly in Scotland; followed two wins at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) over the winter with creditable third of 15 at Ayr (2m, soft) three weeks ago; more needed off unchanged mark.

runners_data.name: Moon Chime
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 210-day break, 3lb claimer takes over riding duties
runners_data.comment: Recent Flat run should have blown away the cobwebs; possibilities on last spring's form
runners_data.spotlight: In good form over hurdles last spring, winning at Stratford and Hexham (both 2m, good to soft); he's only 2lb higher than for the second of those wins, and a recent run on the Flat after six months off should have blown away the cobwebs; impossible to discount in first-time tongue-strap.

runners_data.name: Indemnity
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent record on good ground, 10lb rise for Plumpton win is testing
runners_data.comment: 4-6 on good ground over hurdles; ready winner at Plumpton; up 10lb but he's thriving
runners_data.spotlight: 4-6 on good ground over hurdles, notching another personal best when returning from a break to win readily at Plumpton (2m; 15-2) last month; a 10lb rise demands further improvement but he's thriving and should encounter suitable conditions again.

runners_data.name: Hamlet's Night
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who disappointed as favorite last time, hurdles record much better than Flat
runners_data.comment: Had no obvious excuse when fifth to Indemnity at Plumpton last month; others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: 0-14 on Flat turf and a beaten favourite at Musselburgh two weeks ago; his hurdles record (2-7) is better but he had no obvious excuse when fifth to Indemnity at Plumpton (33-1) last month; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Star Of Guiting
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with two winter wins at Musselburgh, had excuses when eighth at Aintree
runners_data.comment: Won twice at Musselburgh in the winter and has had excuses since; interesting each-way
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in the winter and has had excuses since, making late headway after a slow start when eighth of 21 at Aintree four weeks ago; probably in much better heart than recent form-figures suggest, and he's an interesting each-way proposition.

runners_data.name: No Ordinary Joe
runners_data.note: Prominent racer finally back to winning ways at Sandown, quick return after 14-day break
runners_data.comment: Ended long losing run over 2m4f at Sandown; not sure to be so effective back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Finally took advantage of some leniency from the handicapper when winning at Sandown (2m4f, good) two weeks ago, always in the firing line; still well treated on old form but he's not sure to be so effective back over this shorter trip.

runners_data.name: Gibbs Island
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who ran well in the County at Cheltenham, 57-day break since last run
runners_data.comment: Shaped well when seventh of 23 in the County at Cheltenham; still only five; major player
runners_data.spotlight: Easy winner at Chepstow (2m, good) last October and he took a big step back in right direction when seventh of 23 in the County at Cheltenham (2m1f, soft); missed the Scottish Champion Hurdle last month due to heavy ground; still only five and he's 1lb lower than in the County; major player.

runners_data.name: Bucephalus
runners_data.note: Front-runner with solid C&D form, 7lb claimer Tucker takes over from more experienced jockeys
runners_data.comment: Front-runner; third over C&D last time; in the mix but several of these look less exposed
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who regularly gives his all and was beaten off only on the run-in when third to Dance And Glance over C&D (good) five weeks ago; should make another bold bid but several of these look less exposed.

runners_data.name: Made U Blush
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse getting weight as 4yo filly, progressive profile with Listed win last time
runners_data.comment: 4yo filly who gets weight all round; close second at Sandown last time; respected
runners_data.spotlight: 4yo filly who gets weight all round; made it 2-3 over hurdles with a Listed juvenile win at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in January and she improved further when a close second at Sandown (2m, good) last month; open to further progress and she's a second plausible candidate for Dan Skelton.

runners_data.name: Laafi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with high rating but carrying top weight, form figures include a disqualification
runners_data.comment: First past post at Aintree last month only to be disqualified for whip offence; 6lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: Useful on Flat and has quickly reached a similar level over hurdles, posting a career best when first past the post in a big field at Aintree's Grand National meeting (2m, good to soft) only to be disqualified for a whip offence; seeks compensation but a 6lb higher mark will make things tougher.

races.paceDynamic: Bucephalus and Tellherthename are confirmed front-runners who will contest the early pace, with Bucephalus likely to force it from the flag given his front-running style and Tucker's 7lb claim. The honest gallop they set will stretch this 17-runner field over 1m7½f, creating a searching test that will find out the stamina reserves. Several prominent racers like Helnwein, Indemnity and Bubble Dubi will track the leaders closely, but the sustained pace will favor hold-up horses who can finish strongly off a solid tempo. This race shape clearly favors the hold-up merchants and strong finishers who can benefit from the pace injection.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bucephalus and Tellherthename set a genuine gallop and maintain it to 3f out
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will set up perfectly for the closers, with Dance And Glance, Star Of Guiting and Made U Blush able to unleash their finishing kicks. The front-runners will weaken in the final furlong, allowing the patient riders to sweep past.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes moderate and the front-runners compromise each other
scenarios.body: Helnwein, Indemnity and No Ordinary Joe can position prominently and have enough left to kick clear when the pace lifts. Their tactical positioning allows them to avoid traffic while still benefiting from the tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Bucephalus or Tellherthename gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The leader can control the race from the front, picking up the pace when it matters most while the field struggles to close the gap. Bucephalus has the course form to execute this perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If there's significant interference or the favorites are caught wide throughout
scenarios.body: The pace becomes stop-start, negating the class advantage and allowing horses like Magna Victor or Gibbs Island to capitalize on a messy race. Form gets thrown out the window in a tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Bucephalus and Tellherthename could compromise each other early if both go forward too aggressively
Made U Blush is getting significant weight as a 4yo filly but faces much stiffer opposition than recent wins
Moon Chime returns from a 210-day absence with an inexperienced 3lb claimer taking the ride
Several horses including Bubble Dubi and Star Of Guiting return from lengthy breaks exceeding 50 days
The good ground favors Indemnity who has a perfect 4-6 record on this surface over hurdles

races.name: Pertemps Network 'Junior' National Hunt Flat Race (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bold Acclaim
runners_data.comment: Related to several useful types; stable has the odd bumper winner and runs two
runners_data.spotlight: 9,000euros foal; by Kew Gardens; dam unraced half-sister to winners Heron Heights (smart 2m3f-3m chase), Witness In Court (useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase) and Stellar Magic (useful 2m3f-3m1f hurdle/chase); stable has the odd bumper winner and runs two.

runners_data.name: Magic Feld
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to a French bumper winner; booking of Harry Skelton catches the eye
runners_data.spotlight: French-bred half-brother to 1m4f AQPS Flat and useful 2m1f-3m hurdle winner Hititi; dam 1m4f/1m5f AQPS Flat and 2m1f hurdle winner; a second runner for Tom Weston and he makes some appeal on pedigree; the booking of Harry Skelton catches the eye.

runners_data.name: Mister Dam
runners_data.comment: Out of a cross-country chase winner; looks likely to be of more interest over obstacles
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a French 2m4f/2m7f cross-country chase winner; looks likely to be of more interest over obstacles and longer distances; hooded for debut.

runners_data.name: Sodeto
runners_data.comment: Cost 1,000gns as a 3yo; rare runner in this sphere for mainly Flat yard
runners_data.spotlight: Cost 1,000gns as a 3yo; Ribchester half-brother to 1m4f winner Kate The Cook, out of a 1m2f/1m6f winner; rare runner in this sphere for mainly Flat yard; fitted with hood for debut.

runners_data.name: St Gabriel
runners_data.comment: 27,500euros 3yo; yard does well (19%) in bumpers; one of the more likely newcomers
runners_data.spotlight: 27,500euros 3yo; half-brother to French 2m2f hurdle winner Atacama Du Mazet; dam maiden half-sister to winners Askar Tau (2m/2m2f Group 2) and Arango (Group placed 1m2f/1m3f), out of German 1m-1m2f Listed winner; yard does well (19%) in bumpers; one of the more likely newcomers.

runners_data.name: You Be Lucky Jean
runners_data.comment: The only filly in the line-up; appealing on pedigree and worth monitoring in the market
runners_data.spotlight: By Maxios; dam dual bumper and 2m4f hurdle winner, out of French 1m2f winner; the only filly in the line-up; makes some appeal on pedigree and worth monitoring in the market.

runners_data.name: Running Happy
runners_data.comment: Clearcut winner on debut at Huntingdon; more required to defy penalty but it's possible
runners_data.spotlight: Clearcut winner on debut at Huntingdon (good ground; 11-2) five weeks ago; will need some improvement to defy a penalty but it's certainly possible and his stable remains in good form.

runners_data.name: Plan De Stan
runners_data.comment: Hereford second is the best form on offer here; should be in the thick of things again
runners_data.spotlight: Built on debut form (had wind surgery afterwards) when 1l second of 11 at Hereford (good ground; 3-1 joint-favourite) five weeks ago, leading from over 2f out until near the finish; that's the best form on offer and he should be in the thick of things again.

runners_data.name: Sevenkingsmustdie
runners_data.comment: Well behind stablemate Aribidia when sixth at Warwick and needs a big leap forward
runners_data.spotlight: Originally cost 425,000gns as a yearling; finished well behind stablemate Aribidia when sixth of 11 at Warwick (9-1) six weeks ago, racing freely despite the hood (now left off); needs a big leap forward.

runners_data.name: Aribidia
runners_data.comment: Improved when third at Warwick, rallying; type to keep progressing and high on the list
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise in a big field on debut and he shaped well when third of 11 at Warwick (good; 3-1) next time, rallying; type to keep progressing and he's high on the list.

races.name: Pertemps Newton Handicap

runners_data.name: Myrrh
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the likely pace scenario, with her third at Doncaster showing improved form on handicap debut that could continue here.
runners_data.comment: Respectable third at Doncaster on handicap/seasonal debut; up even further in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Ran close to her 2yo best when third of eight on handicap debut at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago, and could come on for the outing; may stay today's even longer trip (mixed messages from pedigree).

runners_data.name: Double Combo
runners_data.note: Natural leader who will control the race from the front, but 112 days off and 0-4 record creates questions about finishing power.
runners_data.comment: In frame last three starts; cheekpieces could eke out some improvement
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 but has made the frame on his last three starts, leading for most of the way when fourth on handicap debut at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in January; doesn't look thrown in but cheekpieces could eke out some improvement.

runners_data.name: Salkadan
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who found his best form when stepped up to 1m4f last time, perfectly positioned for this race shape.
runners_data.comment: Much improved upped to 1m4f when second at Kempton; may still have untapped potential
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced over 6f/7f first three starts but he fared much better upped to 1m4f when short-headed at Kempton six weeks ago; should be just as effective on turf and may still have untapped potential.

runners_data.name: Barbury Boy
runners_data.note: Gelded and improved winner last time who combines hold-up style with strong finishing kick, ideal for this tactical setup.
runners_data.comment: Much improved to win at Beverley; that form has been boosted; solid credentials
runners_data.spotlight: Gelded and upped in distance, showed much improved form to win 12-runner race at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) on reappearance, pulling well clear with a rival who has since gone one better; should be at least as effective over this longer distance; still unexposed and has solid credentials.

runners_data.name: Crown Inn To Win
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer at longer trips who gets significant weight relief but faces stronger opposition than usual.

runners_data.name: Due To Shine
runners_data.note: Low-level hold-up runner who is 4lb out of the handicap and lacks the class to compete at this level.
runners_data.comment: Low-level maiden; looks up against it from 4lb out of the handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Low-level maiden; looks up against it from 4lb out of the handicap.

runners_data.name: Keep It Classic
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but has a tendency to fade in the finish, making him vulnerable even if the pace sets up right.

runners_data.name: Corduroy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose form has been inconsistent and showed poor effort on stable debut last time out.
runners_data.comment: Ran badly on stable debut at Wolverhampton last month and others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Up and down in his short career to date, running badly on stable debut at Wolverhampton last month; others appeal more.

races.paceDynamic: Double Combo will lead from the gates with no other natural front runners to challenge him early. Kevin Stott can dictate a steady, uncontested pace over this stamina-testing trip, having led for most of the way on his last start. The race will develop into a classic staying test where the front runner controls the fractions, setting up a sprint finish from the home turn. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, as they'll get the perfect scenario of a controlled pace followed by a sprint finish that suits their tactical style.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Double Combo gets an easy lead and maintains strong galloping rhythm
scenarios.body: The front runner controls every fraction and proves hard to pass up the straight, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground despite the honest pace. Double Combo's stamina and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The controlled fractions set up perfectly for horses with a turn of foot, allowing the best finishers to sweep past Double Combo in the final furlong. Barbury Boy and Salkadan benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Changes
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys push forward mid-race to challenge Double Combo
scenarios.body: The pace quickens from the 6f marker as hold-up horses move earlier than planned, creating a more genuine test that suits horses with both stamina and pace. This compromises both front runner and pure closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Double Combo goes too slow and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from 3f out with multiple horses converging simultaneously, favouring whoever has the best turn of foot regardless of early position. Pure speed trumps tactics.

watchPoints.text: Double Combo's jumping from the gates - if he's slow away or contested early, the entire race dynamic changes dramatically.
Barbury Boy's position turning in - if he's too far back when the pace quickens, his winning chance diminishes significantly.
Keep It Classic's effort level in the final 2f - his tendency to fade makes him unreliable even in favorable scenarios.
Salkadan's position at halfway - needs to be within striking distance to utilize his proven finishing kick effectively.
Crown Inn To Win tracking the pace - if he gets into an early battle, his lightweight advantage gets compromised.

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap

runners_data.name: Mohaaraj
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form but faces stronger pace than previously encountered
runners_data.comment: Strong finish to win a 1m Kempton maiden in February; brings potential to handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped well on his 2yo debut and justified strong market support to win a Kempton maiden in February, in workmanlike fashion but he was well on top at the finish; moves into handicaps with considerable potential.

runners_data.name: Applesandpears
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 173-day break which could blunt her early speed
runners_data.comment: Improved with each start as a 2yo, winning two AW novices; market useful now handicapping
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive in three starts last autumn, finishing runner-up on her Leicester debut (6f, good) before winning AW novices at Chelmsford (7f) and Newcastle (6f); should stay 1m and she brings potential to her handicap debut; market instructive.

runners_data.name: Sea The Power
runners_data.note: Loves to lead but trainer struggling for winners this season at 0/7
runners_data.comment: 1m novice win for Adrian Keatley last September; makes stable debut in a competitive race
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in an Ayr novice (1m, good to soft) in September, his third start, and that form has worked out; fluffed his lines when favourite for a 1m2f nursery at Nottingham one month later; has left Adrian Keatley and makes his stable/seasonal debut in a competitive race; not fully exposed and it will be interesting to see if his backers return.

runners_data.name: Aerial Silk
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but gelding operation and step up to mile both question marks
runners_data.comment: Promise in three 7f runs as a 2yo; more to come upped to 1m for his handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in three 7f runs as a 2yo; gelded since last seen; plenty of stamina on the bottom line of his pedigree and he could step forward now upped to 1m for his handicap/seasonal debut.

runners_data.name: Dodge City
runners_data.note: Prominent runner fresh from French racing but poor recent Chantilly effort concerns
runners_data.comment: 1m1f win in France last year; last of 7 (1m2f, soft) on return; tough mark; headgear now
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in Britain as a 2yo before winning a 1m1f conditions event in France last August; well held in a 1m2f conditions event at Chantilly last month (soft ground); not obviously well treated back in a handicap but new cheekpieces could give him a lift.

runners_data.name: Blue To Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist switching stables to Ruth Jefferson after promising juvenile form
runners_data.comment: Three wins for Karl Burke as 2yo; down the field on stable debut last month; gelded since
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins (one 5f and two 7f, including here) for Karl Burke as a 2yo; 50-1 and never threatened in a Newmarket handicap on his seasonal/stable debut last month (1m, good); gelded since; others look stronger.

runners_data.name: Delinquent
runners_data.note: Patient type progressing through handicaps with Burke's 14% strike-rate providing confidence
runners_data.comment: Off the mark at Southwell two weeks ago (good Topspeed figure); in a deeper race today
runners_data.spotlight: Steady progress in AW handicaps this year, getting off the mark at Southwell (1m) two weeks ago; that effort was backed up by the Topspeed figure but he is in a deeper race today.

runners_data.name: Jeddaal
runners_data.note: Front-runner benefiting from gelding operation with 7lb claimer reducing burden
runners_data.comment: Improved on 2yo efforts when winning 7f Catterick maiden last month; more to come over 1m
runners_data.spotlight: Promise as a 2yo; gelded prior to his reappearance in which he won a 7f Catterick maiden in good style; hit with a 6lb rise for that but 1m should suit and further progress seems likely; trainer in good form.

runners_data.name: Silver State
runners_data.note: Devastating front-runner in visor whose recent turf form sets the standard
runners_data.comment: 4-6 since handicapping; turf wins on last two starts; up in class but still a key player
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of four of his six handicap runs since fitted with a visor, including two impressive front-running displays since returned to turf (1m; good to soft and good to firm); 5lb higher in a stronger race but he cannot be passed over at all lightly, such has been his progress.

runners_data.name: Harlequin Breeze
runners_data.note: Prominent runner using 7lb claim but Group 3 last time represents significant step up
runners_data.comment: Stiff task in the Nell Gwyn on return and came up well short; improvement needed for 1m
runners_data.spotlight: Took a good step forward when second of 11 at Newmarket last November (7f, good to soft), her third start; in at the deep end in the Group 3 Nell Gwyn on her reappearance and came up well short; not obviously well treated and the step up to 1m needs to spark extra.

races.paceDynamic: Silver State, Applesandpears, Sea The Power and Jeddaal will ensure a genuine gallop from the start with Harlequin Breeze also likely to race prominently. Silver State has shown devastating front-running form on turf while Applesandpears and Sea The Power both prefer to make their own pace, creating a potentially fierce early battle. The strong early tempo will test stamina reserves over this stiff Haydock mile. This pace dynamic strongly favours horses with proven hold-up tactics who can finish strongly, as the front-runners will likely compromise each other.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State, Applesandpears and Sea The Power all go forward together creating relentless early pace
scenarios.body: The fierce gallop will collapse the field in the final furlong, setting up a tactical finish for those held up. Blue To Blue and Delinquent's patient styles become major assets as the pace-setters pay the price.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple pace-setters show mutual respect and settle into a more measured rhythm
scenarios.body: A slower tempo allows Silver State or Jeddaal to control proceedings and kick clear when ready. Front-runners can dictate terms and prove too strong for the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners like Dodge City and Aerial Silk move up to challenge the leaders turning for home
scenarios.body: The injection of pace stretches the field but doesn't collapse the leaders completely. Mohaaraj's prominent style becomes ideal as he can track the move and respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all the front-runners go too hard early in genuine fast ground conditions
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and the entire leading group stops dramatically in the final two furlongs. Only the most patient hold-up horses can capitalise from the carnage.

watchPoints.text: Silver State could prove too strong if allowed uncontested lead given his recent front-running dominance
Multiple pace-setters Applesandpears, Sea The Power and Jeddaal may neutralise each other early
Blue To Blue switching from Karl Burke to Ruth Jefferson on stable debut could face settling issues
Delinquent stepping up from all-weather success to turf handicap company for first time this season
Ashley Lewis's 5lb claim on Jeddaal could prove crucial if race becomes competitive finish

races.name: Pertemps Network Spring Trophy Stakes (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Lake Forest
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with Group-level class returning from long layoff but has strong fresh record
runners_data.comment: Second in Group 1 last summer; very dangerous if ready to roll after six months off
runners_data.spotlight: Won the Group 2 Gimcrack as a 2yo and finished second in the Group 1 City Of York (7f, good to firm) last August; made no show in two Group 1s in Australia in the autumn and he's since been gelded; returns in a much lower grade than usual and very dangerous if ready to roll after six months off.

runners_data.name: Holguin
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up type who has won this exact race twice before and goes well when fresh
runners_data.comment: Last seen posting career best when winning at Chester; has gone well fresh; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Won the same Listed event at Chester in 2023 (soft) and 2025 (good), posting a personal best in latter; not seen since but he has plenty of form when fresh and cannot be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Release The Storm
runners_data.note: Unbeaten front-runner with only two career starts, major improvement expected
runners_data.comment: 2-2 last summer; unexposed but this is a far sterner test of his credentials
runners_data.spotlight: Unbeaten 4yo; followed debut win at Leicester (7f, good) last summer with ready all-the-way success at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) two weeks later; open to plenty more improvement but this is a far sterner test of his credentials.

runners_data.name: Poet Master
runners_data.note: Prominent runner and 7f specialist who found only Myal too strong last time out
runners_data.comment: Found Myal just too strong in conditions event at Thirsk on return; may build on that
runners_data.spotlight: 7f specialist, a Group 2 winner in July 2024; below best when finding Myal just too strong in conditions event at Thirsk (7f, good; 15-8 favourite) on return; may build on that but he's 4lb worse off with that rival here.

runners_data.name: Audience
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on 12-race losing streak but significant drop in grade from Group 1 company
runners_data.comment: Group 1 winner in his prime but increasingly hard to predict
runners_data.spotlight: Group 1 Lockinge winner in 2024 but on a 12-race losing sequence and he ran badly on his last three starts in Dubai early this year; this is a drop in grade but he's proving increasingly hard to predict.

runners_data.name: Heathcliff
runners_data.note: Hold-up type switching from AW to turf after winning Lingfield handicap in February
runners_data.comment: In good form on the AW this year but this is a warm race for his turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: In good form on the AW this year, winning a handicap at Lingfield (7f) in February and running creditably when fourth in similar event at Newcastle (6f) on Good Friday; has shown he's up to Listed level but this is still a warm race in which to be making his debut on grass.

runners_data.name: Ten Bob Tony
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up horse who won Group 3 over course and distance on reappearance last year
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; fine third in French Group 1 last autumn; probably needed reappearance; solid
runners_data.spotlight: Reappeared last season with victory in the Group 3 John Of Gaunt over C&D and he signed off the campaign with a fine third in the Group 1 Foret at Longchamp; might have needed the run when fourth in Listed event at the Curragh six weeks ago; versatile in terms of the ground; solid chance.

runners_data.name: Balmacara
runners_data.note: Front-runner with inconsistent 2025 form returning from 197-day break
runners_data.comment: Returns from a layoff and may find that conditions place  the emphasis too much on speed
runners_data.spotlight: None too consistent in 2025, running well when second in 1m Listed event at Sandown (soft) in September but poorly twice afterwards; returns from a layoff and may find that conditions place the emphasis too much on speed.

runners_data.name: Myal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent strike-rate who beat Poet Master convincingly last time
runners_data.comment: Likeable type; dug deep to win at Thirsk; may not have reached his ceiling just yet
runners_data.spotlight: Likeable 5yo with a good (7-18) strike-rate; shaped well in Listed event at Doncaster on reappearance and dug deep to win conditions race at Thirsk (7f, good) next time; may not have reached his ceiling and is high on the list.

runners_data.name: Palmar Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent type who ran creditably in Listed races on last two AW starts
runners_data.comment: Creditable fourth last two starts but does not have an obvious chance on the figures
runners_data.spotlight: 5-19; creditable fourth in Listed races last two starts, not beaten far at Wolverhampton (7f) on latest; should give his running again but quite a few of these have more obvious claims on the figures.

runners_data.name: Beauty Destiny
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making British debut after five wins in Hong Kong, flashed tail last time
runners_data.comment: Five Hong Kong wins; well held on British debut; headgear back but he looks up against it
runners_data.spotlight: Won five times over 6f in Hong Kong between November 2024 and March 2025, but he was only sixth of seven on British debut at Newcastle (AW; 7-2; flashed tail) seven weeks ago; headgear returns today but he still looks up against it.

races.paceDynamic: Balmacara and Release The Storm will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. Their presence guarantees an honest pace that will stretch the field and create a true test of stamina over this 7f trip. The sustained tempo will set up the race for the hold-up horses and those with proven finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can stay wide of trouble and deliver their challenge late, particularly Lake Forest, Holguin, and Ten Bob Tony who all possess the tactical speed to capitalise on a truly-run contest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong with both leaders going at it
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will perfectly suit the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade who can pick off tired leaders. Lake Forest, Holguin, and Ten Bob Tony all have the class and finishing speed to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters drops away early leaving a more moderate tempo
scenarios.body: Myal or Poet Master can track the remaining leader and strike with a well-timed challenge in the final furlong. Their prominent style allows them to stay close enough to pounce when the pace slackens.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Release The Storm gets an uncontested lead with Balmacara struggling early
scenarios.body: The unbeaten 4-year-old can dictate terms and potentially have enough left to hold off late challenges. His two career wins were both front-running performances and he's open to significant improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters go too slow in the early stages trying to outwait each other
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows more horses to remain competitive turning for home, creating a messy finish. This chaotic scenario could benefit an outsider getting a dream run through.

watchPoints.text: Release The Storm and Balmacara both want the lead which could create a suicidal early pace
Lake Forest returning from 182-day layoff but Haggas horses often need the run first time back
Holguin has won this exact race twice before and historically goes well fresh after breaks
Audience flashed tail in Dubai suggesting possible behavioural issues may resurface
Beauty Destiny's tail-flashing debut suggests he may not have adapted to British racing yet

races.name: Pertemps Handicap

runners_data.name: Diligent Resdev
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 275-day break with strong form at this trip but fitness a major concern
runners_data.comment: Failed to win last year but ran some good races, including on his reappearance; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Won the 2024 Ayr Bronze Cup in fine style (6f, good); 0-5 in 2025 but looked to retain all his ability; conditions won't be an issue and he has run well first time out in each of his seasons of racing; chance.

runners_data.name: Bravo Zulu
runners_data.note: Prominent runner switching back to turf after inconsistent AW campaign, 7lb claimer Ashley Egan a potential weakness
runners_data.comment: Mixed bag on AW this winter; returns to turf in a competitive event
runners_data.spotlight: Did well last year but this winter's AW campaign was up and down; returns to turf in a competitive race and may come up short again.

runners_data.name: Ata Rangi
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner returning from 182-day absence, likely to get uncontested lead but stamina questions
runners_data.comment: C&D winner off 2lb lower last September; can go well fresh; needs serious consideration
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins for Ed Walker last season and positives can be drawn from the fact that one was on his seasonal return and the other was over C&D (good ground); returns from a six-month break on a manageable mark and a promising claimer is booked; contender.

runners_data.name: Warm Spell
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse well treated on best form but recent Thirsk run suggests he needs this race
runners_data.comment: Good chance on last year's best efforts; sharper for last month's return; each-way shout
runners_data.spotlight: Well treated on last season's best efforts and a recent run at Thirsk should have sharpened him up; trip and ground suit and he is another to consider in an open race.

runners_data.name: Son
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form for Tim Easterby, went close last time and drop in weights continues
runners_data.comment: Went desperately close on last month's stable debut at Thirsk (7f, good); solid contender
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't progress for Richard Hannon but, having dropped in the weights, he went desperately close to making a winning debut for Tim Easterby three weeks ago, staying on strongly at Thirsk (7f, good); 1lb higher today but he attained a BHA rating of 106 in his pomp; contender.

runners_data.name: Diamondonthehill
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner but AW form may not translate, and handicapper has kept him busy
runners_data.comment: String of good AW runs since November; not much wiggle room off current mark though
runners_data.spotlight: He has turned in a string of good runs on the AW since November but such consistency ensures he gets little respite from the handicapper; others may prove better treated today.

runners_data.name: Havana Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from wind surgery and 155-day break in competitive heat
runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 with two solid AW runs (after a wind op); returns to turf in a competitive race
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled last summer but underwent wind surgery in September and he ended 2025 with two solid AW runs; returns from a five-month break in a competitive race.

runners_data.name: Glenfinnan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse prone to fading in finish, Doncaster flop last time concerning despite conditions excuse
runners_data.comment: On a good mark and his reappearance isn't the run to judge him on; return to 7f is a plus
runners_data.spotlight: He should be winning races off this mark and his down-the-field effort at Doncaster six weeks ago isn't the race to judge him on; better can be expected back up at 7f.

runners_data.name: City Captain
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form with encouraging seasonal reappearance, trip and ground ideal
runners_data.comment: Progressive for yard; met unexposed winner at Thirsk latest; mark unchanged; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Did well for Harriet Bethell last season and his two runs this year have been encouraging, second of 13 to an unexposed one at Thirsk three weeks ago; mark left unchanged; big player.

runners_data.name: One Night Thunder
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose Thirsk flop last time was disappointing given strong summer form
runners_data.comment: Down the field on his Thirsk return but last summer's 7f form brings him right into it
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field on his reappearance at Thirsk three weeks ago but last summer's form brings him right into the reckoning and he could take a step forward today.

races.paceDynamic: Ata Rangi stands alone as the confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead, with the prominent runners Bravo Zulu, Son, Diamondonthehill, Havana Blue and City Captain content to track rather than press. This creates a sustainable pace that won't stretch the field early, allowing the hold-up horses Diligent Resdev, Warm Spell, Glenfinnan and One Night Thunder to stay in touch throughout. The lack of early pace pressure means this race will develop into a sprint finish where stamina and tactical positioning matter more than pure speed. This moderate pace scenario strongly favours prominent trackers who can get first run on the leader, while also giving the hold-up horses a realistic chance if they can find racing room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Ata Rangi gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to conserve energy before asserting, while prominent trackers fail to respond quickly enough. Hold-up horses are left with too much to do despite the moderate gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets first run on Ata Rangi
scenarios.body: The moderate pace sets up perfectly for a horse tracking the leader to strike decisively in the final two furlongs. Ata Rangi's long absence becomes a factor when challenged.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes even slower and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The lack of early gallop allows the back markers to stay closer than usual, setting up a cavalry charge finish. Superior class or fitness tells in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The moderate pace creates a bunched field turning in, leading to traffic problems and a messy finish where luck in running decides the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Ata Rangi may get too easy a lead early if prominent runners are content to sit, allowing him to dictate completely
Traffic problems likely in straight as multiple hold-up horses look for racing room simultaneously
Bravo Zulu's 7lb claimer Ashley Egan may lack experience for this tactical affair in competitive company
Diligent Resdev's 275-day absence is extreme even with his class advantage from Bronze Cup win
Son's recent close second suggests Tim Easterby has him spot on and the weight drop continues
